chunks: And whatever is in it from Bakkar ibn Kurdum, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan—may Allah have mercy on him—from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ʿIsa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Bakkar ibn Kurdum.

key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: A transmitter in the sanad/isnad, referring to Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar.
key_terms.بَكَّارِ بْنِ كُرْدَمَ: A narrator from whom reports are transmitted in this chain.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formula indicating direct reporting by the compiler through the stated chain.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Bakkar ibn Kurdum in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Bakkar ibn Kurdum in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance lies in documenting the transmission pathway and preserving the source history of the hadith material.
